Frequently Asked Questions About Time
When and where is Time being held?
Time takes place on Sat, 05 Dec, 2026 at 06:45 am to Sat, 05 Dec, 2026 at 06:45 am at Hawston, Western Cape, South Africa, Hawston, Western Cape, South Africa, Hermanus.
Who is organizing Time?
Time is organized by Divine Appointment Church .
Who is this event for? Is it right for me?
Time is ideal for curious learners, students, and skill-builders looking to gain hands-on knowledge and practical expertise in a focused, interactive setting. Whether you're a first-time attendee or a longtime enthusiast in Hermanus, this event is thoughtfully curated to deliver a standout experience worth every moment. If Time sounds like your kind of event, don't wait - spots fill up fast.
